newsitem.title: UK: BA warns on B777s cargo pallet height.
newsitem.headline: BA warns on B777s cargo pallet height.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo said that it has issued an "urgent update" dealing with pallet dimensions for freight being moved on the carrier's Boeing Co 777 aircraft.
"This change has been made due to the current height of pallets causing continual damage to the aircraft ceiling," it said in a statement.
It added that the maximum allowable height is now 62 inches, including net, while pallet bases remain unchanged.
The carrier said all freight being sent on or transhipped onto 777s must meet these requirments.
If it does not "adhere to these changes, the freight may have to be offloaded", it said. No further comment on the need for the update was immediately available from BA World Cargo.
